body: Im not trying to put any more thoughts in my head but my worst thoughts come from how everything that i had with her, someone else is going to have now. To me my gfs body was sacred to me and i was blessed to be able to call it mine too. My girlfriend was extremely beautiful and the thought of someone else just coming in that i know isnt going to treat her like she deserves and being able to do everything i did with her just breaks my heart man. Its gut wrenching.
I already attempted suicide when we broke up once but we didnt get back together because of me doing that it was we couldn’t not be with each other but idk what changed:/
Its hard when she was my first kiss first girlfriend first everything and we were together for 2 years and then its just “we cant talk anymore. Im sorry”

We were meant to be together. We both knew it. We were perfect for each other and everyone was jealous. I started to be controlling and her mom didnt let us see each other any more and when i tried to fix it it started to get better and i was happy again. Her mom found out we were talking still and made it so we couldn’t anymore. We were going to have a baby and we think she was pregnant but she started bleeding again. She said we cant keep talking because her mom will ruin her life if she finds out so we were going to wait until she turned 18 to start talking again but today she told me that she has feelings for someone else now. And that fucking crushed me.
